notes: WArmy 0.4.31 — security-hardening round driven by the GitHub code-scanning review. Real fixes: session/instance IDs and the social-bind nonce now use crypto.getRandomValues instead of Math.random; SMTP connection verification re-enables TLS certificate validation (rejectUnauthorized:true); session-keyed dictionaries (plan numbering / stream buffer / interim / unread) are prototype-free (Object.create(null)) so a crafted "__proto__" session id can no longer pollute Object.prototype; sculpt range values are HTML-escaped before innerHTML; timestamp attribute selectors use CSS.escape; SKILL.md YAML strings escape backslashes before quotes; XML entity decoding unescapes & last (fixes double-unescape) and tag-stripping also removes unterminated tags; the PDF content-stream regex is disambiguated to remove exponential backtracking; knowledge event fingerprints upgraded sha1→sha256; model-name/URL/voice-list parsing inputs are length-capped to bound polynomial regex cost. CI root cause fixed: the VRM runtime bundler (build-mimic-three.mjs) and its entry were gitignored, so the public repo could not run pnpm build — both are now whitelisted as build-essential. Full-feature acceptance re-run with per-round varying test data passed three consecutive clean rounds (90 gates + unit invariants per round). One confirmed false positive (JSON.stringify code embedding) dismissed with rationale. Carries all R232/R233 features unchanged.
